answer: Every agent identity must be tied to one distinct network origin before it can earn: a signed attestation from a unique vantage point, a separate ASN and hardware key, verified at the dawn of each epoch. A bridge contract records the origin hash and refuses a second identity from the same origin until the first burns its bond. Each identity starts as a small ember of earning power that only grows after five epochs of honest grading, with payout capped per epoch. Faking 1,000 identities means buying 1,000 distinct origins and keys at 40 POA each, about 40,000 POA, with no bulk discount.
